# repository type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:repositoryType`](gmeow-repositoryType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/repositoryType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The version-control system of a repository — a value from the open [`gmeow:RepositoryType`](../classes/gmeow-RepositoryType.md) vocabulary (git, hg, svn, fossil, …). Functional: a repository has exactly one VCS type.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Repository`](../classes/gmeow-Repository.md) -> [`gmeow:RepositoryType`](../classes/gmeow-RepositoryType.md); functional
